narr: A negatively tilted trough was moving through southern California and northern Baja which tapped plenty of subtropical moisture. Locally heavy rain developed along the east slopes of the Blacks Range and brought flash flooding and wind damage to the Monticello area.
ev: Social media video showed evidence of mud flows and damage from flash flooding near the town of Monticello.
